findings.comment: When bevelEnabled is false (or options specify bevelSegments: 0), bevelSegments is 0. As a result, the loop for ( let b = 0; b < bevelSegments; b ++ ) never executes, leaving contractedContourVertices and expandedHoleVertices empty. triangulateShape is called with empty arrays, resulting in faces.length === 0, which completely skips generating both front and back lid/cap faces for non-beveled extrusions.

When checking the wrap-around connection between the last point and the first point (when i === points.length, so currentIndex === 0), points.splice( currentIndex, 1 ) splices index 0. This removes the initial vertex of the shape rather than the duplicate closing endpoint, inadvertently shifting the starting vertex and altering the shape's UV alignment and vertex order.

If points has fewer than 2 elements (e.g., an empty hole array or a single degenerate point), cleanPoints will access points[0] as undefined or splice a 1-point array into an empty array. A guard at the beginning of the function will prevent unintended side effects on degenerate input.
